address: Heckfield Place, Heckfield, RG27 0LD, United Kingdom
bio: Within Heckfield Place – a Georgian country house hotel decorated with the owner’s extensive post-war British art collection – you’ll find this charming, orangery-style dining room looking out over a lake and parkland. Sustainability drives everything they do here, with a great number of ingredients coming from the estate’s own farm; these are fashioned into light, clean dishes that rely on honest, natural flavours. Why not start by ordering the plate of farm vegetables to share, giving you an opportunity to really taste the garden?...
